summary: The chord-selection and fiber-mass estimates are substantially justified, but the candidate is not a complete valid proof as written. Its principal line sums use M_z where M_z has not been defined, and its final cited implication does not cover the genuinely possible singleton case q(E)=0.
critical_errors: M_z is defined only for lattice fibers with w_z>0, but (8), (43), and the surrounding argument sum M_z over every z in ell intersect Z^2. Such a line has infinitely many lattice points outside the base projection and may also have zero-volume fibers, so these displayed expressions are undefined without an explicit zero convention or a restriction of the sums.
gaps: The final application of accepted fact b220933817d23295 to the rank-q(E) restricted body is outside that fact's hypotheses when E is a singleton: then q(E)=0, whereas the accepted fact assumes a positive integer base dimension n. This case is not vacuous, since a line can have exactly one positive-volume lattice fiber and can satisfy (10).

The proof does not explicitly justify transferring the halfspace-depth bound obtained in the lower-dimensional restricted body back to the original ambient body. This requires restricting each original ambient halfspace to the affine hull and using monotonicity of mixed volume.

The chord lemma includes the all-zero sequence, but in the first case (23) incorrectly declares a quantity strictly positive after multiplication by r_0^d. When r_0=0 the quantity is zero. The desired weak inequality still follows, but the written strict step is false and the degenerate case is not separated.

In (37), the proof writes the lattice points as a+k u using the a from ell=a+R u, although that a was not assumed to be a lattice point. The condition L_ell>0 permits choosing a lattice anchor on ell, but that reparametrization is not stated.
repair_hints: Define M_z=0 for every zero-volume or empty lattice fiber, or restrict every M_z sum explicitly to positive-volume fibers.

Handle q(E)=0 directly from the fiber-depth definition, and use b220933817d23295 only for q(E)=1; also state the primitive-lattice coordinate identification and the monotonic transfer from the restricted body to C.
Separate the r_0=0 chord-lemma case and choose an actual lattice point on ell as the indexing anchor.
